correctness.rationale: Exact cyclic-run/junction-bijection identifies all fixed points including constant orbits and yields a rational zeta by formal power-series algebra. The iid macro-marker encoding is a measurable isomorphism a.s. with cyclic Bernoulli suspension, gives entropy log2/(k+1), and by the primary source unique MME. A bracketing coupling controls each finite cylinder exponentially on divisible periods. Off divisible periods only constant fixed points exist. The exact 01 cylinder masses prove distinct subsequential limits. An independent finite direct enumeration matched 67 checks for k=1..4 and n<=14; the infinite conclusion is established analytically, not inferred from tests.

value.rationale: Uniform finite-period sampling is a canonical approximation scheme for invariant equilibrium statistics. This example is intrinsically ergodic yet exhibits two completely different weak-* periodic sampling limits on explicit arithmetic subsequences, unlike a convergence claim suggested by uniqueness of MME. The exact fixed-point counts, rational dynamical zeta, sharp zero/one cylinder witness and exponential rates make the model a precise benchmark for nonmixing coded systems. The result is not just a renaming of generator entropy or a marginal normalization check.
